text: Author-study iteration 0 brief: the accepted research review (iteration 2) left advisories RES-009 to RES-011, which the packet does not carry; the brief named that review's result file as context to be weighed, not followed. The brief also listed the register rules that guidance/editorial.md and the three-document profile already state and on which the previous Claude 1962 run's study reviews failed three times (closing roll calls, texts credited with the study's links, repeated inference markers, restating closers, borrowed four senses, unattributed reported views).
